encounters.name: Silt-Reader Maren
dialogue_intro: The ground underfoot changes from soil to damp shale. Brackish water pools between the rocks.
A woman sits cross-legged by a still pool, trailing her fingers through the water. Ripples carry images — places, faces, things you have not seen.
"The past is not dead. It is not even past." She looks up. "And you are about to dig through the grave of the world."
dialogue_outro: Maren withdraws her hand from the water. The pool goes still.
"You carry the Root-Binder's stone. Good. You'll need it below."
She smiles — sad, knowing. "The Silt-Reader sees. And I see you reaching the seal. What comes after... I cannot see."

encounters.name: Warden Aelin
dialogue_intro: The summit is bare rock, wind-scoured and silent. A woman in white stands at the edge of a vast crater.
She does not turn. Her voice carries without effort.
"I have held this post for forty-three years. I have watched friends grow old and die. I have watched the seal breathe."
She faces you. Her eyes are kind. Her blade is not.
"You have walked through my Reach, defeated my wards, and proven yourself. But I cannot let you descend. Not because I am cruel. Because I have seen what the seal holds."
"And I swore it would never wake."
dialogue_outro: Aelin's blade shatters. She falls to one knee, her hand still raised as if to hold you back.
"You are stronger than I was at your age. Stronger than I am now."
She presses something into your hand — a key of pale crystal, warm to the touch.
"The seal has three locks. This is the first. The other two... you will find them deeper than I can follow."
"When you see what lies beneath — judge me kindly."

encounters.name: Aelin, the Last Steward
dialogue_intro: Below the summit, in the chamber of the first seal, Aelin waits one last time.
She has shed her white mantle. She wears the cracked and faded plate of a soldier who has fought a war no one remembers.
"I knew you would come. I hoped you would not."
She raises a blade that burns with pale fire. The seal behind her hums.
"I have kept this gate for forty-three years. I will keep it one hour more."
Her voice breaks — just slightly. "For the love I bear the world above, I will not let you pass."
dialogue_outro: Aelin falls. The seal cracks. Light — ancient, terrible — bleeds through the fissure.
She smiles, blood on her lips. "It is done, then."
She presses a key into your hand. The second lock.
"The third key... is not in this region. Seek the forge city. Seek Cinderhold."
Her eyes close. "Tell the world above that Aelin of the Fallow Reach kept her post to the end."
